scope: B-level port of the public receipt-only command for results, followups, and materials. Existing current Bot ownership, schema 5, request and digest binding, saved outcomes, byte bounds, and no-creation read snapshot. Managed cleanup authority and persisted formats unchanged.

baseline.command: The actual legacy CLI returned null for an existing unretired result, its exact saved receipt after cleanup, and code 3 for a foreign conversation. The extracted base native build returned unavailable for all inputs.
baseline.linux: The base featureless native package also rejected peer result on an imported nonempty WAL with no shared-memory index. The SQLite rebuild changed only WAL ctime and created the derived index. File device, inode, size, modification time and persistent byte hashes were unchanged.
baseline.repair: On Linux cold initialization the reader binds the opened WAL generation to its before/after content hash. After the connection is confirmed it rechecks the strict file identity around the query. A same-size mutation with the original mtime fails the content proof.

macosArm64.oracle: Actual old compiled CLI and canonical SQLite writer. Tests include active and retired receipts, changed request, foreign owner, corrupt digest, unauthorized operation, oversized input, split UTF-16 summary, and cold WAL.

linuxAmd64.oracle: Imported active and retired copies from the actual legacy writer with nonempty WAL and no shared-memory index. Read all three receipt kinds and both fixed-result states in fresh copies. Every before/after database and WAL content hash matched.
